name: sw-router
description: ACTIVE router that detects development tasks and spawns specialized agents. MANDATORY for: React, Vue, frontend, dashboard, UI - spawn sw-frontend agent. GitHub, API, repository - spawn sw-github agent. TDD, testing, Vitest - spawn sw-testing agent. Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform - spawn sw-infra agent. ML, AI, training - spawn sw-ml agent. Mobile, React Native - spawn sw-mobile agent. Payments, Stripe - spawn sw-payments agent.
